name: Chulbule Teekha Tadka Flavour
ingredients_raw: Rice grits (43.5%), edible vegetable oil (palmolein oil / rice bran oil / cotton seed oil), corn grits (17.5%), gram grits (4%), sugar, dehydrated vegetable powder {onion powder (2.45%), ginger powder (0.2%), garlic powder & tomato powder}, *spices & condiments {red chilli powder (1.12%), amchur powder, coriander powder (0.24%)}, black salt, salt, hydrolysed vegetable protein (soya), acidity regulator (INS 330), colour (INS 160c), flavour (natural & nature identical flavouring substances) & flavour enhancer (INS 627, INS 631). *Used as natural flavouring agent.
